Chapter 01 — Workplace Reality

The Reality of
Our Routine

Think about your day so far. You woke up, sat at breakfast, sat in your car or train, arrived at the office — and sat down again.

The human body evolved over millions of years to move, hunt, and walk. It was never built to remain folded at 90° for 12 continuous hours.

Chapter 02 — Biomechanics

What Sitting Does
To Your Spine

Sitting increases lumbar disc pressure by 40% to 90% compared to standing. Over time this causes disc flattening, sciatica, and chronic lower back pain.
Slouching just 2 inches forward exerts up to 30 lbs of crushing strain on your cervical spine, locking neck muscles into perpetual spasms.
Within minutes of sitting, electrical activity in leg muscles drops to zero, blood circulation slows by 50%, and calorie burn drops to 1 kcal/min.

Cheap Chairs vs Engineering

❌ Conventional Office Chair

  • Fixed armrests force perpetual shoulder shrugging
✅ Wakefit Ergonomic Chair

Chapter 05 — Product Innovation

The Wakefit Gravita

Engineered to move dynamically with human anatomy — providing continuous active spinal support throughout 12-hour workdays.

Biomimetic S-Shape Backrest — Aligns precisely with the spine’s natural lordotic curve. The 2D adjustable lumbar pad takes 100% of strain off lower back vertebrae.
Waterfall Front Seat Edge — Slopes gently downward at the thighs, eliminating arterial pressure points and preventing leg numbness during long sitting sessions.
2:1 Synchro-Tilt Mechanism — Backrest reclines from 90° to 135° while seat tilts dynamically, decompressing spinal discs and opening hip angles.
3D Padded Armrests — Height, depth, and angle adjustable. Supports forearms perfectly, preventing wrist strain and trapezius muscle tension.
BIFMA-Certified High-Tension Mesh — Breathable imported mesh dissipates body heat instantly while maintaining structural resilience for years.
